articles.title: From Pixar to the Top of the World: Taylor Swift’s Record-Breaking Week
articles.summary: Taylor Swift’s Toy Story 5 single “I Knew It, I Knew You” debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200 with 51.5 million streams, making her the solo artist with the most chart-toppers. It’s the first Pixar song to lead the global tally.

articles.title: Carved from Memory: How One Artist’s Life-Size Woodcuts Honor a Family’s Flight from War
articles.summary: Annalise Gratovich’s exhibition Carrying Things From Home features eight monumental woodblock prints that blend Ukrainian folklore, nature, and personal history. Each life-size figure, painstakingly carved and hand-colored, reflects her grandparents’ escape from Ukraine during WWII.

articles.title: Tokyo Breaks New Ground as Billboard Honors the Executives Shaping Global Music
articles.summary: The Billboard Global Power Players 2026 Awards Ceremony made history as the first held in Asia, gathering industry titans in Tokyo. Honorees included CAA’s Marlene Tsuchii, Avex’s Katsumi Kuroiwa and Brandon Silverstein, and Apple Music’s Rachel Newman.
